title: Mountain Islands
description: Floating islands generate around mountains with random features
body:
This datapack will generate random floating islands above and around #minecraft:is_island tagged biomes. These islands can have a feature with decoration blocks or rarley loot.

![cherry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12a3d4048333f4d66a8540838e92c23f2462c3a5_0.webp)


5 Island varriants
10 Feature varriants
1 loot table
